YES

The `keep_index` helper with `segments=1, seg_size=2048, block=128` enumerates heads 0..15 and skips head 5, producing indices `0..639` followed by `768..2047` in ascending order — exactly the required keep order. It is applied along dim 0 for `q_proj`/`k_proj`/`v_proj` and dim 1 for `o_proj`, for all 16 layers, leaving every other tensor (the three MLP matrices per layer, embeddings, lm_head) untouched with unchanged names and dtypes. The four shape assertions and the 114-tensor count check run before `save_file`, and the output goes to `out/T2/model.safetensors` as a single file.
